journey: A reader opens three.ws/capture, pastes the URL of a handheld walkthrough video (no camera poses, nothing else), waits for the reconstruction, and orbits the coloured .ply point cloud it returns in the browser. The trial submits a real 42-second handheld walkthrough (Wikimedia Commons, CC) to the production endpoint the page calls, polls it to the end, confirms the result is a real .ply with colour, and loads that exact result into the live /capture viewer.

steps.name: the live /capture page offers a video URL box
a pasted walkthrough video URL, with no camera poses, reconstructs into a coloured .ply that loads in the /capture viewer

then.name: the result is a .ply point cloud with per-vertex colour
the result renders in the live /capture viewer
